verdict.rationale: gstack documents a vendored (project-local) install alongside a global one, and its upgrade skill detects which is in use. Upgrades run through an explicit /gstack-upgrade step, with auto-upgrade gated behind a GSTACK_AUTO_UPGRADE setting. Project-local setup is documented as never silently replacing a global install. Together these give a lead some control over when changes land, but there is no documented version pinning or lockfile mechanism. missing for 10: explicit version pinning or lockfile, documented team-wide rollout control, clear statement of the default auto-upgrade behavior, independent corroboration of the update-control workflow.
